pairs.registryProposal: canonical-fallback-serving defines the unit as a page/lesson; for structured catalog-like documents (a preset manifest of name/description/member strings) the standard could say whether per-field fallback counts as per-key catalog fallback (legitimate) or as splicing (forbidden). Judged here as splicing because the overlay zips arrays by index with no baseline.
